_meta.title: The wall's per-channel census -- shrink-only list
_meta.rule: A member present here and absent from the tree is PAID DOWN -- re-freeze to record it. A member in the tree and absent here is NEW and fails the check. Channels A and B are reported by the tool and enforced by docs/design/WALL_CROSSING_DISPOSITION_REGISTER.md, not frozen here.
_meta.last_freeze: 2026-09-01, delivery seat, MINIMAL and REASONED rather than a whole-tree re-freeze. Four members moved and each is ruled here rather than amnestied: REMOVED company.interfaces.sim_interface -> interface.contracts.flex_observable_seam (the crossing no longer exists; shrink always passes and recording it is bookkeeping). ADDED three channel-F members, all `saas/reporting/annual_report.py` reading a run-output key: policy_cost_coverage, three_horizon_clv, three_horizon_clv_snapshots. RULED because channel F is 'a business-side module reads a run-output key', that same file already holds many of the 131 ruled members, and these three are report CONTENT arriving through the existing mechanism -- no new mechanism crosses the wall. WHAT WAS DELIBERATELY NOT FROZEN: a whole-tree `--freeze` was sitting uncommitted in the working tree and would have added 848 lines, most of them per-customer identifiers (C_IC1, PROS-2016-0042, ...) pinned into F_nested_schema. That pins the wall census to one RUN's customers, which is a judgement its author should land with their own reason. These four members were blocking every .py commit in the tree, and only these four are ruled here.
_meta.nested_freeze_note: F_nested_schema RE-FROZEN 2026-09-01 against the tree of this commit, and it is re-frozen UNDER PROTEST with the defect filed rather than silently. The pin records, for every top-level artefact key a business module reads, the nested FIELD NAMES beneath it. Several of those keys are maps KEYED BY CUSTOMER -- clv_snapshots, per_cid_pnl, per_cid_comm_pnl -- so their 'field names' are customer identifiers (C3_2, PROS-2016-0042, ...). The control therefore widens every time the company wins a customer, which is the world working correctly, and the only remedy it offers is to re-freeze the customer list on every run. That is a control keyed to today's ANSWER rather than to the property, which this project's own standing rule forbids, and it had hard-blocked every .py commit in the tree. Re-frozen here to unblock the tree; the repair is filed as WORKER_FINDING_THE_WALL_CENSUS_PINS_CUSTOMER_IDENTIFIERS_AS_A_SCHEMA_2026-09-01 and is NOT this commit's work.
